articles.title: Hong Kong’s central bank puts a number on lenders' quantum preparedness. It's very low.
articles.snippet: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority published a whitepaper on the quantum preparedness of Hong Kong’s banking industry and its first Quantum Preparedness Index.

articles.title: AmericanFortress proposes quantum-safe crypto wallet protection without fund migration
articles.snippet: The proposed cryptographic scheme aims to protect existing Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana wallets from future quantum attacks without requiring users to move funds or change wallet addresses.

articles.title: Hong Kong prepares banks for quantum threats amid tokenization push
articles.snippet: The HKMA aims to make Hong Kong’s banking sector fully prepared for quantum-related security risks by 2030 as the city expands tokenized finance.
